## Fixes for the Bases transition

**Update the same Just Simple Planner plugin to 0.5.4.** This release includes the 0.5.3 correction for the migration dialog's **Create Base** button and fixes another issue found during the expanded in-app regression tests.

When a Planner tab was hidden and a note changed, a background render could save its horizontal position as zero. Returning to the tab could then show a different date window. Hidden planners now retain their last visible position and apply pending updates when their pane becomes visible. This also preserves Notebook's vertical position and states restored while a tab is hidden.

For a manual update, replace `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` with the files below, then reload the plugin or restart Obsidian. Keep `data.json`, your Markdown notes and existing `.base` files. Existing Bases planners do not need another migration. GitHub-based installers can detect 0.5.4 as a newer stable version.

### Classic view and migration

The classic view is deprecated but remains available. **No removal date is set.** This is the same plugin and the same notes. **Create Bases planner** creates a new Base that reads existing entries and thread notes; it does not move or rewrite them. The new Base can then use its own filters and property mappings.

[Migration guide](https://github.com/DavidHurtadoAI/just-simple-planner/blob/0.5.4/docs/MIGRATION.md) · [Guía en español](https://github.com/DavidHurtadoAI/just-simple-planner/blob/0.5.4/docs/MIGRACION.es.md) · [Bases features and screenshots](https://github.com/DavidHurtadoAI/just-simple-planner/releases/tag/0.5.2)

Validation details and the reproducible native regression runner are in [TESTING.md](https://github.com/DavidHurtadoAI/just-simple-planner/blob/0.5.4/TESTING.md). The release workflow checks the source, builds all three installable files and verifies their provenance.
